0022600194.text: The Houston Rockets (7-2, 1st in the Southwest, 2nd in the West, on a one-game losing streak) visit the Phoenix Suns (2-5, 12th in the West, on a one-game winning streak) for the Rockets' 10th game of the season. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and has Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Rockets won 4-0 against Phoenix in 2025-26, including a 119-105 win in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
